faculty.name: Timothy Buschman
faculty.summary: Studies the roles of prefrontal cortex, parietal cortex, and basal ganglia in executive control, using behavioral tasks, electrophysiology, and optogenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究前额叶皮层、顶叶皮层和基底节在执行控制中的作用，使用行为任务、电生理学和光遗传学方法。

faculty.name: Rebecca Carey
faculty.summary: Studies how social class influences close relationships and their impact on health and well-being, focusing on lower-class contexts.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会阶层如何影响亲密关系及其对健康和福祉的影响，重点关注低阶层群体。

faculty.name: Jonathan Cohen
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological mechanisms of cognitive control and its disturbances in psychiatric disorders like schizophrenia and depression.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知控制的神经生物学机制及其在精神疾病如精神分裂症和抑郁症中的紊乱。

faculty.name: Alin Coman
faculty.summary: Studies how social cognition shapes collective behaviors, using cognitive methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会认知如何塑造集体行为，采用认知方法。

faculty.name: Joel Cooper
faculty.summary: Studies attitudes and attitude change, particularly cognitive dissonance and its vicarious experience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究态度及其变化，特别是认知失调及其他人的间接体验。

faculty.name: Molly Crockett
faculty.summary: Studies how social and technological factors influence knowledge and moral beliefs, using experiments and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会和技术因素如何影响知识和道德信念，使用实验和计算模型方法。

faculty.name: Nathaniel Daw
faculty.summary: Studies how people and animals learn from trial and error to make decisions, combining computational, neural, and behavioral perspectives.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人和动物如何通过试错学习进行决策，结合计算、神经和行为视角。

faculty.name: Asif Ghazanfar
faculty.summary: Studies the developmental and evolutionary bases of social communication, focusing on the interaction between neural systems, the body, and socioecological context.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会交流的发育和进化基础，重点关注神经系统、身体和社会生态背景之间的相互作用。

faculty.name: Adele Goldberg
faculty.summary: Studies how humans learn language using general cognitive processes and brain mechanisms, focusing on constructions and metaphors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类如何使用一般认知过程和大脑机制学习语言，重点关注构式和隐喻。

faculty.name: Michael Graziano
faculty.summary: Studies the brain basis of consciousness, focusing on how the brain arrives at the conclusion of having subjective experience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究意识的脑基础，关注大脑如何得出具有主观体验的结论。

faculty.name: Tom Griffiths
faculty.summary: Studies how people solve complex computational problems, using methods from statistics, machine learning, and AI to explain human behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何解决复杂的计算问题，使用统计学、机器学习和人工智能的方法来解释人类行为。

faculty.name: Uri Hasson
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of brain-to-brain communication and natural language processing using ECoG data and deep learning models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑之间的交流和自然语言处理的神经基础，使用ECoG数据和深度学习模型。

faculty.name: Sabine Kastner
faculty.summary: Studies large-scale brain networks during cognition using electrophysiology and imaging in humans and macaques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程中大规模脑网络的运作机制，使用电生理学和成像技术在人类和猕猴中进行研究。

faculty.name: Brenden Lake
faculty.summary: Studies human cognitive abilities like few-shot learning and goal generation, using neural network modeling and child behavior data.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类认知能力如少量学习和目标生成，使用神经网络建模和儿童行为数据。

faculty.name: Casey Lew-Williams
faculty.summary: Studies how young children learn from their communicative environments using eye movements, infant-directed speech, and neural synchrony.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴幼儿如何从交流环境中学习，使用眼动、婴儿定向言语和神经同步的方法。

faculty.name: Tania Lombrozo
faculty.summary: Studies how people explain their environment, learning, judgments, and decisions, blending psychology and philosophy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何解释环境、学习、判断和决策，结合心理学和哲学的方法。

faculty.name: Yael Niv
faculty.summary: Studies reinforcement learning and decision-making processes, using computational models to understand optimal brain mechanisms.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究强化学习和决策过程，使用计算模型来理解最优的大脑机制。

faculty.name: Erik Nook
faculty.summary: Studies how emotions and emotional language interact, using developmental, neuroscientific, and translational approaches to understand emotional development and psychopathology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪和情绪语言之间的相互作用，采用发展、神经科学和转化方法来理解情绪发展和心理障碍。

faculty.name: Kenneth Norman
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain forms and modifies memories, using computational models and neuroimaging to explore learning rules and the role of sleep.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何形成和修改记忆，使用计算模型和神经成像探索学习规则和睡眠的作用。

faculty.name: Kristina Olson
faculty.summary: Studies how children and adults understand and navigate gender diversity, focusing on identity development and social transitions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何理解和应对性别多样性，重点关注身份发展和社会过渡。

faculty.name: Elizabeth Levy Paluck
faculty.summary: Studies how social norms and behaviors shift in real-world settings using field experiments and large-scale interventions to reduce prejudice and intergroup conflict.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会规范和行为在现实世界中的变化，通过大规模实地实验和干预措施减少偏见和群体冲突。

faculty.name: Emily Pronin
faculty.summary: Studies self-perception versus other-perception asymmetries and the effects of thought speed on mood and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自我感知与他人感知的不对称以及思维速度对情绪和行为的影响。

faculty.name: Eldar Shafir
faculty.summary: Studies reasoning, judgment, and decision-making, particularly in contexts of poverty and policy applications.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究推理、判断和决策，特别是在贫困情境下的决策以及政策应用。

faculty.name: Anuj Shah
faculty.summary: Studies the role of attention and automaticity in decision-making and social conflict, using lab and field experiments to inform public policy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究注意力和自动化在决策和社会冲突中的作用，使用实验室和实地实验来指导公共政策。

faculty.name: Nicole Shelton
faculty.summary: Studies how prejudice and situational factors affect intergroup interactions and the development of cross-racial friendships.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究偏见和情境因素如何影响跨种族互动以及跨种族友谊的发展。

faculty.name: Stacey Sinclair
faculty.summary: Studies how interpersonal interactions shape individual thoughts and actions through social tuning and implicit homophily, without conscious awareness.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人际互动如何通过社会调谐和隐含的同质性影响个体的思想和行为，而无需意识参与。

faculty.name: Susan Sugarman
faculty.summary: Studies everyday human experiences and the mind through comparisons of childhood and adulthood, and examines historical psychological thinking from Aristotle to Freud.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究日常人类经验和心智，通过将儿童期与成年期进行比较，并探讨从亚里士多德到弗洛伊德的心理学思想史。

faculty.name: Diana Tamir
faculty.summary: Studies how the human mind thinks about and predicts others' minds, using neuroimaging and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类思维如何思考和预测他人的心智，使用神经成像和行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Jordan Taylor
faculty.summary: Studies how explicit cognitive strategies interact with implicit motor adaptation during skill acquisition, using computational processes and neural systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究显性认知策略与隐性运动适应在技能习得中的相互作用，通过计算过程和神经系统的分析。

faculty.name: Taylor Webb
faculty.summary: Studies how higher-order cognitive processes like reasoning and metacognition are implemented in distributed neural networks, both biological and artificial.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究推理和元认知等高级认知过程在生物和人工分布式神经网络中的实现机制。

faculty.name: Elke Weber
faculty.summary: Studies decision-making processes and their application to environmental and financial decisions, using a variety of methods including lab and field experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究决策过程及其在环境和金融决策中的应用，使用实验室和实地实验等多种方法。

faculty.name: Carlos Brody
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes like memory and decision-making in rats using computational and behavioral techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的认知过程，如记忆和决策，使用计算和行为技术。

faculty.name: Bradley H. Dickerson
faculty.summary: Studies how motor output is structured by sensory input in fruit flies, using imaging, physiology, and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉输入如何结构化果蝇的运动输出，采用成像、生理学和行为学方法。

faculty.name: Tatiana Engel
faculty.summary: Studies how coordinated neural activity drives behavior and cognition using computational and theoretical approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究分布式神经环路如何驱动行为和认知功能，采用计算和理论方法。

faculty.name: Annegret Falkner
faculty.summary: Studies how social experience and internal state influence sensory perception and social motivation, shaping behavioral choices in mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会经验和内部状态如何影响感觉感知和社会动机，从而塑造小鼠的行为选择。

faculty.name: Jesse Gomez
faculty.summary: Studies the development of the human brain and its cognitive functions from gestation to adolescence, using fMRI, qMRI, dMRI, and behavioral observations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究从妊娠到青春期的人类大脑及其认知功能的发展，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、定量磁共振成像（qMRI）、扩散加权磁共振成像（dMRI）和行为观察。

faculty.name: Elizabeth Gould
faculty.summary: Studies how brain plasticity contributes to behavior during development and adulthood, using neurogenesis, synaptogenesis, and hormone manipulations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑可塑性在发育和成年期对行为的影响，使用神经发生、突触发生和激素操纵的方法。

faculty.name: Christina K. Kim
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits and molecular mechanisms underlying cognitive functions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经回路和分子机制，了解认知功能。

faculty.name: Andrew Leifer
faculty.summary: Studies how collective neural activity drives animal behavior and higher cognitive functions in C. elegans using optical recording techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究集体神经活动如何驱动动物行为和高级认知功能，使用光学记录技术在秀丽隐杆线虫中进行研究。

faculty.name: Carolyn McBride
faculty.summary: Studies the genetic and neuronal basis of behavior in mosquitoes, focusing on how changes in olfactory circuits drive preference for human odor.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究蚊子（如埃及伊蚊）的行为遗传和神经基础，特别是如何改变嗅觉回路驱动蚊子偏好人类气味。

faculty.name: Mala Murthy
faculty.summary: Studies how male flies use visual and self-motion cues to pattern their courtship songs, and how female flies process these songs to choose mates.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究雄性果蝇如何使用视觉和自我运动线索来调节其求偶歌声，并研究雌性果蝇如何处理这些歌声以选择配偶。

faculty.name: Catherine Jensen Peña
faculty.summary: Studies how early life stress affects brain development, using rodent behavior and RNA sequencing to understand mechanisms of depression risk.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期压力如何影响大脑发育，使用啮齿动物行为和RNA测序来理解抑郁症风险的机制。

faculty.name: Jonathan Pillow
faculty.summary: Develops statistical methods for analyzing neural data and studies sensory-motor decision making and working memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发统计方法分析神经数据，研究感觉-运动决策和工作记忆。

faculty.name: H. Sebastian Seung
faculty.summary: Studies brain wiring diagrams using connectomics to understand brain function and development, particularly in fly and mouse visual systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑连接图谱以理解脑功能和发育，特别是在果蝇和小鼠视觉系统中的应用。

faculty.name: David Tank
faculty.summary: Studies persistent neural activity in neural circuits, linking it to short-term memory across various brain areas and species.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经回路中的持久神经活动，将其与不同脑区和物种中的短期记忆联系起来。

faculty.name: Samuel S. Wang
faculty.summary: Studies the role of the cerebellum in sensorimotor learning, working memory, and social interaction in mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究小鼠中延髓在传感器运动学习、工作记忆和社会互动中的作用。

faculty.name: Taylor W. Webb
faculty.summary: Studies how higher-order cognitive processes like reasoning and metacognition emerge from distributed neural networks in both human brains and artificial systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究高级认知过程（如推理和元认知）如何在人类大脑和人工系统中的分布式神经网络中涌现。

faculty.name: Ilana Witten
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits for reward learning and decision making using optogenetics, electrophysiology, and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究奖励学习和决策的神经电路机制，使用光遗传学、电生理学和计算建模方法。
